sandbox.fixMac: macOS inoshandisa yakavakirwa-mukati bhokisi rejecha pa /usr/bin/sandbox-exec. Tangazve Novera kana yavepo.
sandbox.fixWindows: Windows inoshandisa AppContainer. Tanga patsva Novera kuti uedze zvakare.
